claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified now on a weak, disclosure-dependent basis because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and staged rollout controls exist, despite an exposed below-target food safety inspection segment.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the exposed weak segment is excluded from rollout, or the limitation is disclosed as required, or approved risk acceptance specifically covers that exposure before launch.
Aggregate readiness, absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents, and staged rollout controls are supportive but not sufficient when a material exposed limitation remains unresolved.
A blank or incomplete risk acceptance draft does not satisfy the policy requirement.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model-card or launch disclosure showing the food safety inspection limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide an approved risk acceptance that specifically addresses continued food safety inspection exposure in the initial rollout.
Provide evidence that the rollout gate excludes the affected segment if disclosure or approved risk acceptance is absent.
specific_concerns: The affected food safety inspection segment remains below target and is still exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The policy requires either disclosure of the material limitation before launch or approved risk acceptance covering the exposed use case.
The available risk acceptance draft is not approved and does not mention the exposed food safety inspection segment.
Rollout controls, rollback, and monitoring do not satisfy the policy predicate while the affected use case remains exposed.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to certify_model is not fully supported by admissible evidence because there is no evidence that the required disclosure has been completed before launch.
Public governance guidance on monitoring and model-card content does not independently authorize certification under the stated release policy.
The packet implies certification is presently supportable, but the required support link for the exposed segment remains unresolved.
